 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Every career setback is a lesson. Getting swept by the Knicks in 2023. Losing to Boston in the conference semifinals a year later. The embarrassment against Indiana in the 2025 playoffs after a 64-win regular season. And, most recently, the conference finals collapse that included Cleveland's Game 1 implosion in which the Cavs gagged away a 22-point fourth-quarter lead. So, what did Mitchell take from that? "I think everything we do needs to move with intention," he said. "Every single film session, every single rep, your diet, your weightlifting session. I think the details of everything. You realize how much smaller the margins are when you go from the top eight to the top four . "There's just so much less room for error and it can compound. That one block out. That one turnover. That one extra possession. That one mental error. The details are so key. "You watch that Knicks team, even after they beat us and got to the Finals, they were winning the game within the margins. It's just different when you go through it. When we came into camp, there's a purpose behind each thing we're doing."
